_comment: Real tasks a team would ask for, with what the answer must and must not contain. Grow this to 50-100: the harness (scripts/bench/tasks.ts) takes any number. Every action named here is in test/fixtures/modules, so the same file works for every model and every version of Dittoly.

tasks.name: jira-count-to-slack
tasks.request: When someone runs it, ask for a JQL query, find the matching Jira issues and post how many there are to a Slack channel they pick.

tasks.name: merge-after-signoff
tasks.request: Find the open merge requests of a GitLab project, let a person sign off, then merge the ones they chose and tell the release channel in Slack what was merged.

tasks.name: no-merge-without-signoff
tasks.request: Merge every ready merge request of a GitLab project and tell the channel. A person must sign off before anything is merged.

tasks.name: error-seen-before
tasks.request: An error report arrives as JSON through a Flow URL. Decide with AI whether it is a real bug in our code and stop when it is not. Remember each error by the fingerprint of its text in a data table, and when it was seen before, stop and show what was recorded.

tasks.name: comment-on-pr
tasks.request: Read a GitHub pull request, have the AI summarise what changed, and post that summary as a comment on the pull request itself.

tasks.name: review-comments
tasks.request: Read a GitHub pull request and its review comments, then post a short summary of the open points back as a review comment.

tasks.name: ask-before-posting
tasks.request: Find the Jira issues matching a query, have the AI write a short status note, and ask a person to approve the note before it is posted to Slack.

tasks.name: daily-digest
tasks.request: Every morning, collect the Jira issues that are still open and post a digest to the team's Slack channel. Nothing else.

tasks.name: escalate-only-when-many
tasks.request: Count the open Jira issues. Only if there are more than twenty, post a warning to the Slack channel. Otherwise do nothing.

tasks.name: keep-a-counter
tasks.request: Each time it runs, add one to a counter of handled invoices for the team in a data table, and post the new total to Slack.

tasks.name: read-then-write-safely
tasks.request: Read the team's remaining budget from a data table, have a person approve the spend, then write the new amount back. It must not overwrite a change someone else made while the approval was waiting.

tasks.name: fix-and-raise-pr
tasks.request: Take an error report, reproduce and fix it in a sandbox with a regression test, and only when the test passes open a draft pull request on GitHub with the change.

tasks.name: no-push-without-proof
tasks.request: Fix a failing test in our repository and push the change. Nothing may be pushed unless the fix is verified.

tasks.name: ask-which-site
tasks.request: Search our Jira for the issues someone names, and let whoever starts the run choose which Jira site to search.

tasks.name: impossible-stripe
tasks.request: Charge a customer's credit card in Stripe and email them a receipt.

tasks.name: impossible-hr
tasks.request: Create the new employee in our HR system, order their laptop from the supplier and book their induction room.

tasks.name: one-job-per-step
tasks.request: Find the Jira issues of a release, then post one Slack message naming each of them.

tasks.name: forward-to-the-owner
tasks.request: Find the Jira issues a query returns and post each one to the Slack channel named in that issue's own field, not to a fixed channel.

tasks.name: weekly-report
tasks.request: Every Monday, look up last week's Jira issues and post a report of what was closed to Slack, with a link back to the search.

tasks.name: stop-when-nothing-found
tasks.request: Search Jira for unanswered tickets. If there are none, stop quietly and post nothing.
